pr_title: Fix code formatting issues and VS compilation
pr_body:
Also temporarily disable multistage build so that we get a full build
even when there are style issues on Vulkan.

Thanks @javawag for documenting the fix for #33356.

Fixes #33356.

issue_context.title: vulkan - 4.0 dev - cant compile in windows VS 2017, previous version did compile
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
vulkan branch 8b1d5dd from  20191105

**OS/device including version:**
Windows 10 64 bits
VS 2017
python 3.8.0
scons 3.1.1
Intel i7 8750H 16G RAM
Nvidia GTX 1060

**Issue description:**
vulkan branch compiled on windows with previous commit, this one fails almost at the end in math_funcs.h and rasterizer.h

**Steps to reproduce:**
clone vulkan branch from git and compile:

```
git clone https://github.com/godotengine/godot/ --branch vulkan
cd godot
scons platform=windows -j 10 tools=yes target=release_debug
```
